scripts.build:staging: node scripts/validate-firebase-environment.mjs --mode staging && tsc -b && vite build --mode staging
scripts.build:production: node scripts/validate-firebase-environment.mjs --mode production && tsc -b && vite build --mode production
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:frontend && npm run typecheck:functions
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && node scripts/run-function-tests.mjs
scripts.test:functions:secure-student: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --project demo-ecoscolaire --only firestore "vitest run tests/functions/createStudentSecure.spec.ts"
scripts.test:functions:secretary-collections: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --project demo-ecoscolaire --only firestore "node tests/functions/test-record-cash-payment-privacy.cjs && node tests/functions/test-secretary-collections-emulator.cjs && node tests/functions/test-student-account-collections.cjs && node tests/functions/test-cash-closure-integrity.cjs"
scripts.test:functions:expense-ledger: npm --prefix functions run build && node tests/functions/test-expense-ledger.cjs
scripts.test:rules: npx firebase-tools emulators:exec --only firestore "playwright test tests/security/rules.spec.mjs tests/security/payment-allocation-rules.spec.mjs tests/security/staff-rules.spec.mjs tests/security/program-rules.spec.mjs tests/security/pedagogy-rules.spec.mjs tests/security/boardviewer-readonly.spec.mjs tests/security/expense-immutability.spec.mjs tests/security/grades-rules.spec.mjs tests/security/report-card-rules.spec.mjs --config=playwright.rules.config.ts"
